answer: The thread counter is kept in dune and sonnet shows each reset. An copycat as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4813 identities would post 3007 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
